STRUCT_LAYOUT.name: MedicalBayDTO
STRUCT_LAYOUT.MATH: 24 + 4 + 4 = 32 bytes. 32 is a power-of-two cache-friendly row and multiple of 8/16/32; no Pack=1.

STRUCT_LAYOUT.name: InventoryRespawnPenaltyResultSignal
STRUCT_LAYOUT.MATH: 5 * 4 + 4 + 8 = 32 bytes. Public field offsets are guarded in ShinobuRespawnLayoutGuards; Core also validates signal size.

STRUCT_LAYOUT.name: InventoryRespawnDeathAupSignal
STRUCT_LAYOUT.alignment: double3 first, scalar route fields after, explicit 16-byte tail pad
STRUCT_LAYOUT.MATH: 24 + (5 * 4) + 20 = 64 bytes. Public field offsets are guarded in ShinobuRespawnLayoutGuards; Core also validates signal size and finite DeathAUP.

STRUCT_LAYOUT.name: InventoryDeathLootCacheSignal
STRUCT_LAYOUT.alignment: 48-byte AUP first, scalar fields after, explicit 64-byte tail half
STRUCT_LAYOUT.MATH: 48 + 8 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 2 + 2 + 4 + 2 + 46 = 128 bytes. Public field offsets are guarded in ShinobuRespawnLayoutGuards; Core also validates signal size.

STRUCT_LAYOUT.name: LootMagnetSignalEvent
STRUCT_LAYOUT.alignment: metadata stored in existing explicit tail padding
STRUCT_LAYOUT.MATH: 48 + 12 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 8 + 2 + 2 + 36 = 128 bytes; no new Vault buffer and no managed sidecar identity store. `LootMagnetLayoutGuards.ValidateSignalEventLayout()` guards the offsets.
